title: Soft Hearts
textBlocks:
Is your heart SOFT or HARD?
Hello Bravehearts
in today’s lesson you will see that 
the Lord is interested in our hearts

People with SOFT hearts care for others
People with HARD hearts care about themselves

Soft hearts want to follow Jesus
Hard hearts do not want to know Jesus
Moses needs to start building the special tent - the TABERNACLE
and he need all the material to build it like - Gold, silver, bronze, wood and leather
So the Lord says the people who have soft hearts must give.
To give the gold and silver needed to build the Lord’s special tent.
Let us play a game called - OPPOSITES

PRAYER TIME
Dear Lord Jesus 
Thank you for making me
Thank you for my family
Please keep my heart soft
Amen
